title: Tall whites in suits forming a 'high-speed horse formation'
summary: Charles Hall tells of Tall whites in suits forming a 'high-speed horse formation', about 1965-1967 at Indian Springs ranges, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So if you saw them when they were out in the desert, say a/4 mile away, when they all turned on their suits, the force fields from around those suits merged into one. And I speak from direct experience, you would swear there was a giant white floating horse coming at you from out in the desert.

related.note: This is the same giant white horse as the Range Four Harry legend in #1, but Hall explains it as the tall whites' suit force fields merging, not a radioactive horse.

Both describe the tall whites' 'high-speed horse formation', in which merging force fields look like one large white shape at Indian Springs in 1965-67. Here the formation joins fields to make a single larger craft, where the story says it is suits merging.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent 1965 to 1967 on the Indian Springs ranges in the Nevada desert alongside tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites, says they wore suits that gave off a kind of force field. He told podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025 that when a group of them switched on their suits about a quarter mile away, the fields joined into one glowing shape, and from his own experience you would swear a giant white floating horse was coming at you across the desert. He links this to a local legend about a glowing horse on the ranges, which would mean the legend was really these beings seen from far off.
